name: Vancouver Dahlia Society
label: Tuber sale (in person)
note: Tubers from local competitive growers, about $8 each. Sold out the year before, so go early.

name: Victoria Dahlia Society
place: Prospect Lake Community Hall, Victoria, BC
label: Plant and tuber sale (in person)
note: Tubers and plants, including rare varieties. On until sold out.

name: Nanaimo Gladiolus & Dahlia Society
label: Tuber and corm sale (in person)
note: Dahlia tubers and gladiolus corms. Cash, debit or credit.

name: Alberta Dahlia & Glad Society
label: Tuber sale (online)
note: Online sale of tubers. Has also held in-person sales in Lacombe and Red Deer.

name: Hamilton & District Chrysanthemum and Dahlia Society
label: Tuber sale (online, ships in Canada)
time_text: Members first, then open to the public a few days later
note: Online sale; shipping within Canada only.

name: Dahlia Society of Nova Scotia
label: Annual tuber sale (in person)
note: Over 4,000 tubers, but they sell out quickly.
